title: Elderly Man with Heraldic Crest
description: An elderly man with long white hair and a full white beard stands in the foreground wearing a black velvet jacket, light blue shirt, and red polka-dot tie. Behind him is a large ornate black and silver heraldic crest featuring a shield with three pinecones, a knight's helmet, leafy mantling, and a banner reading 'FORET'.

The shield contains three detailed pinecones on a white and black field, topped with a knight helmet and leafy mantling. A black banner below reads 'FORET'.
